scripts.db:migrate: set -a && . ./.env && set +a && pnpm --filter ./server exec prisma migrate deploy
scripts.prod:setup: set -a && . ./.env.production && set +a && pnpm --filter ./server exec prisma migrate deploy && pnpm --filter ./server exec prisma generate && pnpm build
scripts.build: pnpm --filter ./src build && pnpm --filter ./server build && node scripts/stamp-build.mjs
scripts.release: pnpm build && pnpm build:cli && node cli/dist/hanoman.js __pack && (cd dist-npm && npm pack --dry-run)
